channel.title: Cork Safety Alerts - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Cork Safety Alerts (corksafetyalerts.com)

item.title: Landowners Urged to Cut Overgrown Hedges Before End of February
item.description: Landowners have until end of February to cut roadside hedges before seasonal restrictions begin. Report overgrown vegetation to your local authority.

item.title: Love Your Coast Photography Competition Opens for Valentine's Day Entries
item.description: Love Your Coast Photography Competition opens Valentine's Day. €5,000 prize fund. Entries close 15 May. Five categories celebrating Ireland's coastline.

item.title: Cork Businesses Set for Major Boost as Local Enterprise Week Returns in March
item.description: Local Enterprise Week returns to Cork from 2-6 March, with free events and expert advice to help local businesses grow, innovate and create jobs.

item.title: Deceased Animal on N40 Eastbound
item.description: Reports of a deceased dog, eastbound on the N40 South Ring Road near Mahon. Take care on approach.

item.title: Cork City Council Secures €2m EU Funding to Double Home Retrofitting Rate
item.description: Cork City Council secures €2m EU funding to double annual home retrofits from 150 to 300, supporting climate goals and local construction jobs.

item.title: Collision in Little Island
item.description: Reports of a collision on the R623 Little Island between the Eastgate R/A and Ballytrasna. Take care on approach.

item.title: Collision on N40/Slip to Kinsale Road R/A
item.description: Reports of a collision at the eastbound slip to the Kinsale Road R/A, from the N40 South Ring Road. Take care on approach.

item.title: Collision on R639 Rathcormac
item.description: Reports of a pedestrian has been knocked down on the R639 Rathcormac, near Rathcormac Community Centre. Emergency services are en route. Take care on approach.

item.title: Road Closure on M8 Northbound
item.description: Reports of a road closure due to roadworks, northbound, on the M8 Dublin Motorway between Junction 19 (N40/N25) Dunkettle and Junction 18 Glanmire (Cork). Take care on approach.Source: TII Traffic Alerts, 10 February at 20:56.

item.title: Multi-vehicle Collision on N22 Westbound
